newsitem.title: USA: Pop superstar Michael Jackson is father.
newsitem.headline: Pop superstar Michael Jackson is father.

text.p: Pop superstar Michael Jackson is the father of a baby boy, a hospital spokesman said on Thursday.

Cedars-Sinai Medical Center spokesman Ron Wise declined to say when the child was born but said Jackson's wife, Debbie Rowe, and the baby left the hospital at around 8 a.m. PST (1600 GMT GMT). "They're both doing fine," he said.
Wise said he could not say when the baby was born. "Mr and Mrs Jackson have requested that there be no further information other than that the baby was a boy and mother and son are doing fine."

The baby is the 38-year-old reclusive singer's first child. Jackson married his 37-year-old wife in Australia last November after announcing that she was carrying his baby and saying it was due to be born on Friday, Valentine's Day.

Earlier news reports, citing unnamed sources, varied widely on when the birth took place. One local television station said it was at 4 p.m. PST (midnight GMT) on Wednesday, while the New York Post said Rowe had her baby at 6 p.m. PST Wednesday (0200 GMT Thursday. Several television stations said it happened at 1 a.m. PST (0900 GMT) on Thursday.
Jackson was previously married to Lisa Marie Presley, daughter of rock and roll legend Elvis Presley for 20 months. He married Rowe less than a year after the divorce.
